'''''Tcheran''''' is a derivative of ''[[sha'rah]]'', a complex board game. Not much is known about the board game, other than that it was a strategic boardgame that was simpler than ''sha'rah ''and that [[Moridin]] preferred ''sha'rah ''by far.{{ref/book|8|p}} [[Semirhage]] was an indiferent ''tcheran'' player.{{ref/book|6|6}}
